title: AI Video Watermark Remover
description: AI-powered web application for removing watermarks from videos using four techniques: Smart Fill (OpenCV TELEA inpainting), Blur, Pixelate, and Black Box. Features automatic watermark detection, interactive region selection, FFmpeg-based audio-preserving video export, secure file validation, rate limiting, and a bounded processing queue for efficient video processing.

title: 20M Dash Speed Analysis
description: AI-powered sprint analysis tool that processes a 20-metre dash video using YOLOv8 and ByteTrack to track the runner and calculate speed, sprint duration, peak speed, average speed, and form metrics. Generates an annotated playback video with live overlays along with HTML and JSON performance reports. Features asynchronous background processing, real-time progress updates via Server-Sent Events (SSE), and browser-compatible H.264 video export.

title: Overlay Studio
description: AI-powered Background Remover and Video Overlay & Cut Studio built with Flask. Supports transparent image cutouts, custom backgrounds, logo overlays, video trimming, animations, previews, and high-quality exports.
